title: CADKit 0.3.5 artifact refresh and PAR-33 diagnostic ceiling
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Refresh the current published CADKit DWG reader artifact surfaced by docs.rs
Reconcile package documentation with the mutable repository README, changelog, provenance, and DWG format notes
Assess whether CADKit's native/raw common entity view can help diagnose PAR-33 without promoting claims
Make the optional comparison gate precise, fast, fixture-safe, and self-unblocking

sources.observation: The page identifies cadkit-dwg 0.3.5 and describes native/raw object data including common/type-specific fields and raw bytes. Because this is a mutable latest URL and other docs pages lag, it does not bind the archive to the reviewed repository source.

sources.project: TNYCL/cadkit README and DWG format notes
sources.observation: The README describes DWG AC1014-AC1032, growing entity coverage, no DWG writer, and AC1012 untested. Format notes report six-version DWG-to-project-DXF comparisons and 19 Apache Tika structural samples, but use the project's own DXF reader/model and include no independent semantic oracle. REGION/3DSOLID/BODY ACIS is not decoded beyond header/SAT bytes.

The provenance ledger identifies ODA v5.4.1 and ACadSharp cross-check/sample lineage, explicitly attributing R2007 LZ77/container flow to ACadSharp. The current public changelog still ends at 0.2.1, while docs.rs latest identifies 0.3.5; exact package/source correspondence remains unbound.

The documented schema exposes plotstyle flags/handle before material flags/handle, matching the ODA common-field order. This is only an API/schema observation, not evidence that an uninspected 0.3.5 parser consumes those raw fields in that order.

Sections 20.4.1-20.4.2 remain the normative common-entity data and handle-sequence reference. PAR-33 remains open because the available issue evidence does not yet provide the admitted both-references producer sample needed to discriminate the peer disagreement.

planImpact.existingOwner: PAR-33 / OPEN_SPEC_RECONCILIATION; PAR-07/S8 optional structural comparator
planImpact.implementationSummary: Refreshes the CADKit candidate from older 0.3.0/0.3.3 snapshots to the current docs.rs 0.3.5 surface while retaining artifact/source mismatch as a hard gate. CADKit may be a raw structural diagnostic only; its public API ordering does not resolve PAR-33 without a source-audited parser and a qualifying both-reference DWG/DXF pair. Its published format notes explicitly do not decode ACIS geometry or AcDs modeler attachment.
planImpact.nextImplementation: At the existing composed checkpoint only, inspect already-present admitted sample pairs for one entity with both material and plotstyle references. If none exists, record NO_QUALIFYING_BOTH_REFERENCE_SAMPLE and self-unblock. If one exists, bind package checksum to embedded VCS source SHA, inspect the exact decoder, and compare raw flags, handle targets, paired DXF 347/390 roles, and following-cursor closure. Keep PAR-33 open unless all evidence layers agree.

method.limitations: The docs.rs latest crate page, stale version-labeled API pages, and mutable GitHub main documentation disagree on freshness. No archive checksum, embedded VCS SHA, exact lockfile, or source-to-artifact mapping was obtained. No peer code or drawing was downloaded or executed; no qualifying both-reference sample was identified in this research pass.
